scope: Local macOS source/scaffold remediation and isolated consumer qualification; no adopter edits, hosted CI, public npm/shared Yalc publication, Springbar service admission or production deployment.

items.assessment: Fresh creation exact-pins nx/@nx and verifies installed toolchain alignment before app generation.
Resumable creation is outside this batch; existing staged recovery remains.
Fresh workspace identity and source conditions are normalized consistently; unrelated strings are retained.
Extension-local ignores exclude WXT generated output without rewriting root policy.
Plugin and CLI resolve tracked/advertised default HEAD or explicit Git init policy, without guessing main or bypassing clean/default-branch checks.
skipInstall is forwarded to Nx; tests show unchanged lockfile through the deferred callback and settled async turn. The reported post-exit background write is not independently established.
Batch generation or a reviewed automation mode remains separate work.
Generic libraries get Vitest starter/tests configuration; web UI gets JSX/DOM settings and React peer/development dependencies. Node 18 callers can explicitly select testRunner=none.
New Chakra themes use bundler resolution. New Chakra app/theme configs skip third-party declaration checks for the upstream cornerShape defect; own source errors still fail.
Library option descriptions were improved; docs-research/help/topic validation remains separate work.
Zod baseline alignment remains. The Megamono declaration is broader, not narrower, than Playstack requirements.
New Nx18+ Next apps use scoped inference and plain Next configuration; Nx17 keeps its legacy path. Existing applications are not migrated.
No extension-to-web blanket exemption was added; renderer/worker-aware platform policy still needs design and qualification.
packageScope can independently select the npm namespace, preserving legacy scope-only behavior.
Runtime Chakra themes remain web/UI adapters. Portable token separation and reviewed UI composition policy remain.
Tooling and test-context platform handling needs separate policy/source-level work.
New libraries and Next apps use scoped modern lint inference; no broad migration of existing projects or other generators was performed.
Configurable localization-rule exclusions remain.

New theme singletons are peers with matching development dependencies; generic React UI declares React peers. Consumer resolution/context checks are added. A general installed-singleton checker is not implemented.
Localization guidance/catalog integration remains.
Undeclared workspace import diagnostics remain.
Extension JSX, explicit WXT imports, disabled auto-import transforms, test configuration and upstream typecheck ordering are generated.
Generic libraries and extension scaffolds separate production/test checking; theme production config excludes specs.
No blanket sideEffects:false was introduced. Bundle attribution and reviewed entrypoint/subpath work remain.
Declaration-merging lint policy remains configurable application/style work.
React Hooks preset integration remains.
Broader source-versus-built typecheck workflow remains; this batch preserves valid publishable output semantics.
Per-application dependency ownership and closure audits remain.
Unused build-approval cleanup remains.
Fresh creation writes an exact qualified Node pin and matching engines range; existing adopted repositories are not repinned.
Generated Next launchers support PORT, stable application cwd and signal forwarding. Actual Springbar MCP setup/deployment admission is not claimed.

additionalFixes: Publishable library JavaScript/declaration layout matches all package entrypoints in path-alias, composite path-alias and actual pnpm solution workspaces.
Legacy Nx SVG declarations are removed from newly generated plain-Next applications.

qualificationNotes: Initial focused tests used the installed Nx CLI directly after the old pnpm launcher failed; exact pinned pnpm was restored in a task-owned temporary directory for final checks and fresh web installation.
The generic library artifact check exercises path-alias, composite path-alias and actual pnpm solution workspaces and imports the extracted packages through public CJS/ESM entrypoints.
The extension consumer performs isolated local-registry installation, Chrome/Firefox builds/package/tests, JSX, test-error isolation and no-auto-import runtime probes.

The web consumer performs fresh/frozen pnpm installs, theme typechecking and an injected own-source error rejection, singleton resolution, inferred targets, production Next build, injected-port root/nested startup, and listener-closed shutdown checks.
